     WHEN avail_despegar = 'Availability.AVAILABLE' 
     AND avail_competitor = 'Availability.AVAILABLE'
     AND base_price_competitor > 0
     THEN (base_price_despegar_min - base_price_competitor) / base_price_competitor
    ELSE NULL
END AS base_price_variation
